title: A Hotel Worth Checking Out; The Gladstone Variations Features Four Plays, 13

display_heading.headline: A Hotel Worth Checking Out
display_heading.deck: The Gladstone Variations Features Four Plays, 13 Characters And Not A Single Stage

contact_edits.before: The staff includes Sanjay Talwar as a second, ambiguously courteous concierge, and Dov Mickelson as a second bellhop with skills to learn, being as he's discourteously sardonic in one play and sadistic in another. The sum is more than the parts: The hotel takes on a theatrical identity of its own. The show is a hit from the Fringe, produced by Tepperman and Willis for Convergence Theatre, which for these circumstances could hardly be more aptly named. - The Gladstone Variations runs at the Gladstone Hotel through Aug 3. Call 416-504-7529 for details.
